title: Markov State Model of Solvent Features Reveals Water Dynamics in Protein-Peptide Binding.
authors: Raddi, Robert M; Voelz, Vincent A
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文用溶剂特征的马尔可夫状态模型研究p53肽与MDM2蛋白结合中的水动态，属广义蛋白-肽互作，方法（MSM/tICA）可迁移至TF-DNA互作机制研究。
abstract: In this work, we investigate the role of solvent in the binding reaction of the p53 transactivation domain (TAD) peptide to its receptor MDM2. Previously, our group generated 831 mus of explicit-solvent aggregate molecular simulation trajectory data for the MDM2-p53 peptide binding reaction using large-scale distributed computing and subsequently built a Markov State Model (MSM) of the binding reaction (Zhou et al. 2017). Here, we perform a tICA analysis and construct an MSM with similar hyperparameters while using only solvent-based structural features. We find a remarkably similar landscape but accelerated implied timescales for the slowest motions. The solvent shells contributing most to the first tICA eigenvector are those centered on Lys24 and Thr18 of the p53 TAD peptide in the range of 3-6 A. Important solvent shells were visualized to reveal solvation and desolvation transitions along the peptide-protein binding trajectories. Our results provide a solvent-centric view of the hydrophobic effect in action for a realistic peptide-protein binding scenario.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们探讨了溶剂在p53转录激活域（TAD）肽与其受体MDM2结合反应中的作用。此前，我们课题组利用大规模分布式计算，为MDM2-p53肽结合反应生成了831微秒的显式溶剂聚合分子模拟轨迹数据，并随后构建了该结合反应的马尔可夫状态模型（MSM）（Zhou等人，2017年）。在此，我们进行tICA分析，并使用仅基于溶剂的结构特征，以相似超参数构建MSM。我们发现，最慢运动的景观 remarkably 相似，但隐含时间尺度加速。对第一tICA特征向量贡献最大的溶剂壳层，是以p53 TAD肽的Lys24和Thr18为中心、范围在3-6 Å内的那些。我们可视化了重要溶剂壳层，以揭示沿肽-蛋白结合轨迹的溶剂化和去溶剂化转变。我们的结果为真实肽-蛋白结合场景中疏水效应的作用提供了以溶剂为中心的视角。
